thread:
Priya: Heads-up — ACMEHealth wants a bundled POC that includes API + Optimize + Console add-on for 3 months. They're asking for a 25% cross-product discount and onboarding fee waived. POC needs a sandbox with SSO + security questionnaire answered. Any immediate deal-desk or ops blockers?

Joel: Quick clarifying Qs — what's the expected qps / token volume? If inference is heavy we may need a Dedicated trial pool. Also, will Optimize usage include eval slots? That affects cost math.

Raj: Security note: I started the questionnaire; they flagged SSO, data residency, and log export controls. We can offer VPC/private for residency but that adds infra fees.

Ada: From RevOps — standard cross-product discount cap is 20% and that requires >= $10k/mo commit. Onboarding fee waivers are rare for POCs; we normally convert those to onboarding credit. Deal desk will need an ACV projection + strategic justification.

Priya: They are expecting to commit $8k/mo for the 3-month POC with an upsell path after. So below the $10k threshold. They're pressing for 25% to meet budget.

Claire: Legal — to proceed I need confirmation we can use the standard DPA for the POC. If they require Private/VPC we need the infra addendum. Also SOC2 docs are ready to share.

PricingBot: FYI — cross-product discount guidance: <10k/mo => 15% max, 10k-25k => 20% max, strategic exceptions require Dir approval. Onboarding credits permitted as one-time offsets.

Ada: Proposed workaround: offer 15% discount + $5k onboarding credit (one-time). Keeps list price intact for future comps and preserves deal desk thresholds.

Priya: Customer prefers a straight percent discount (not credits). Any chance of an exception? Can we escalate?

Joel: Technical ask from ACMEHealth — Console add-on must include 90-day observability retention (they mentioned EU data residency too). That's an additional paid SKU (retention add-on). If we include it in the bundle, factor that into the total ARR.

Priya: Looping in @Maya — Dir Sales — can we get a one-off approval? I will draft justification: strategic account, likely reference, short POC to enterprise conversion.

Maya: I can consider an exception but need ARR projection and a short exec sponsorship note. If this customer realistically converts to >$150k ARR in 12 months, I can approve up to 22% discount and a modest onboarding credit (not full waiver). 25% is high unless there is clear strategic value.

Ada: Please submit the deal desk packet with expected ARR, renewal probability, and reference potential. I'll prepare the numbers and show impact vs list price.

Priya: Uploading security questionnaire answers + initial SOW draft here: https://redwood.share/acme-poc (internal link). Draft rate lines below for internal review:
```
API (standard) – list: $0.030 / 1k tokens
Optimize (model slot) – list: $500 / slot / month
Console add-on (base) – list: $2,000 / month (includes 30d retention)
Console retention add-on (90d) – list: $800 / month
Onboarding services – list: $7,500 one-time
Bundle list total (3-mo POC) => apply approved discount + onboarding credit
```

Claire: I'll confirm DPA path and attach SOC2 + penetration test summary. If they pick Private/VPC we will surface separate infra pricing and an addendum.

Maya: Provisional approval: 22% discount + $3k onboarding credit, contingent on RevOps packet and Legal sign-off. Priya, get exec sponsor email and the ARR ramp.

Priya: Understood. I'll confirm with ACMEHealth and push for the exec note. Will update thread once I have the sponsor email.

(A few hours later)

Priya: Update — ACMEHealth accepted 22% + $3k onboarding credit. They also agreed to the 90-day retention as a paid line item in the bundle. Moving to finalize SOW and send to Legal for signature. :thumbsup:

Ada: Great — I'll generate the deal desk packet and finalize the numbering for finance. Please attach the approved SOW when ready.

Claire: I'll start the SOW review and attach the DPA. If any Private deployment items remain we will list them as optional addenda.

Priya: Thanks everyone — closing the loop here. Will DM Maya the final signed SOW when complete.
